title: Node builds is missing package-lock.json
author: foarsitter
body_preview: ## What happened?  Updating an old project failed because the build wasn't deterministic. Everything seemed fine except the styling wasn't applied.  ## What should've happened instead?  The container should include `package-lock.json` for deterministic builds.
